extraFacts.fact: Brennan's own end codes: MJ is Male JIC, MP is Male Pipe, FP is Female Pipe, FJ is Female JIC, FJS is Female JIC Swivel, MORB is Male O-ring Boss, MM is Male Metric, MBT is Metric Bite Type, FMS is Female Metric Swivel, MJIS is Male JIS, FJIS is Female JIS, MMORR is Male Metric O-Ring and Retaining Ring, PL is Push Lock; SS in a part number is stainless steel.

faqs.q: What are the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs used for?
faqs.a: The Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs are an Adapt-All range of plugs: 9 part numbers, each listed with its own connections. The range is used to close a port or the open end of a line, for example to blank off a test point or a spare port. The size table describes 9231-24 as "Hydraulic Hose Adapter, Carbon Steel, 24 mm Fitting Size".

faqs.q: What does the part number 9231-14 mean for the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs?
faqs.a: 9231-14 is the Adapt-All number for "Hydraulic Hose Adapter, Carbon Steel, 14 mm Fitting Size" in the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs range. The size table lists every number with its connections. 9231-42 is listed as "Plug, 42X1.5 Metric Side, Carbon Steel".

faqs.q: What sizes does the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs come in?
faqs.a: The Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs are listed in 9 part numbers. Examples: 9231-14 (Hydraulic Hose Adapter, Carbon Steel, 14 mm Fitting Size); 9231-22 (Hydraulic Hose Adapter, Carbon Steel, 22 mm Fitting Size); 9231-30 (Hydraulic Hose Adapter, Carbon Steel, 30 mm Fitting Size). The size table gives the connection on each end of every part number.

faqs.q: How do I match the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs to my port or hose?
faqs.a: Choose the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs by the thread and seat on each end, not by the hose or tube size alone. Measure the port thread and check the seat shape before ordering; the [thread-matching guide](/blog/bridging-two-thread-standards) helps identify an unknown thread.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs?
faqs.a: No pressure rating is published for the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs on this listing. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we confirm the fitting is suitable before you order; the assembly is limited by the lowest-rated part in it.

faqs.q: What is the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs made from, and is stainless available?
faqs.a: The size table items for the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs mention steel, so the material depends on the part number. Check the row for your part number and confirm the material on the quotation.

faqs.q: What documents can I request with the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs?
faqs.a: For the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs we can supply the quotation with the full part number and, where the maker issues them, material and test documents on request. The listing does not state a standard for this range, so name the thread and seat you need on the enquiry and we confirm them before supply.

faqs.q: What mates with the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs?
faqs.a: The Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs mate with a port or fitting of the same thread and seat. A male plug threads into a female port; a female cap or swivel cap goes over a male end of the same thread and seat. For the mating ports see [Japanese JIS 30° adapters](/c/jis-30-adapters).

faqs.q: How do I install the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs without leaks?
faqs.a: For the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs: a plug is made up into the mating port or fitting and is not meant to carry flow: use a clean thread and the seal type that matches the port. Tighten to the maker's make-up torque for the size; the [make-up torque guide](/blog/hydraulic-fitting-make-up-torque) explains how to read a joint after the fact.

faqs.q: Where is the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs made, and can you export it from Dubai?
faqs.a: The listing shows China as the country of origin for the Adapt-All 9231 Series Komatsu Plugs; origin can differ between batches, so we confirm it on the quotation. We ship from Dubai, UAE to destinations worldwide, and the [air or sea guide](/blog/air-or-sea-for-a-fittings-order) helps pick the lane.
